verificationScope: The component harness bundles the real mode service, projection, weather exposure/detector/ladder, dispatcher, analyst batching, classic notice mount and HomeShellOverlay. The real data-loader weather fetch loop is outside this fixture.

The Chromium component run uses a physical Enter key at 360x700. Native uses semantic button activation in an uninstalled Tauri diagnostic host with the unchanged production CSP and a nonpersistent WebKit profile.

The product-index runs load the real HTML and hashed assets generated by the checked-out Vite web and desktop builds, with a guard injected by the host or test browser before document bootstrap. Native retains the production base CSP with a second, more restrictive QA-only network policy. Chromium denies outgoing remote requests and service workers. Product attempts may be blocked; none are forwarded. No real OS notification constructor is called.

The late case removes only the app container after the early notice is visible. A real App constructor failure rejects the exported appStartup promise after main module evaluation. Both the captured Container app not found error and the visible failure disclosure are required. When all storage reads fail, the pre-existing main application may not initialize. The repaired early notice is usable outside #app and separately discloses failed startup. When only the preference is inaccessible, the notice transfers to the regular shell.
